3. Date, Place, and Other Circumstances of the Occurrence:

On March 27, 2026, a formal reimbursement claim was legally submitted to the DHCS
Conlan Center, pursuant to standard state protocols. DHCS properly processed and
directed this claim to L.A. Care Health Plan for adjudication. Pursuant to Assembly Bill
3275 (effective Jan 1, 2026), L.A. Care was legally mandated to pay, contest, or deny this
state-directed claim within 30 calendar days (April 26, 2026). L.A. Care failed to act within
this statutory window. On May 4, 2026, L.A. Care documented its own statutory default
in the State ACMS portal (Exhibit A). Furthermore, L.A. Care has consistently failed to
provide mandated Non-Medical Transportation (NMT) for pharmacy access, forcing out-
of-pocket expenditures to maintain clinical continuity.
